title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Execution
description: Detects base64-encoded PowerShell commands executed via DeviceProcessEvents in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

title: LSASS Memory Access
description: Identifies processes opening a handle to LSASS with suspicious access rights indicative of credential dumping

title: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation
description: Detects scheduled task creation via schtasks.exe with suspicious arguments pointing to temp or user-writable paths

title: Mimikatz Credential Harvesting
description: Detects Mimikatz sekurlsa module usage by matching known command-line patterns in process creation events

title: PsExec Remote Execution
description: Detects PsExec usage for remote lateral movement by identifying PSEXESVC service creation in Windows System event logs

title: DNS Tunneling Detection
description: Detects unusually long DNS query names or high query volumes to a single domain indicative of DNS-based data exfiltration or C2 tunneling

title: Periodic Network Beaconing Activity
description: Identifies hosts making highly regular outbound HTTP/S connections suggesting C2 beaconing behavior based on low inter-request deviation
